fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Parabole Trial', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Page Cream
palette.role: Universal page background and card surface — the warm, almost unbleached paper that defines the entire visual temperature

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text color, dark surface fills, and code-window backgrounds — warm near-black, never pure optical black

palette.name: Rule Black
palette.role: Structural hairlines and borders — 1px lines that define cards, separate sections, and replace shadow as the elevation language

palette.name: Warm Stone
palette.role: Muted body text, secondary borders, and inactive link states — a warm gray that recedes without going cool

palette.name: Linen Beige
palette.role: Secondary elevated surface — warm light beige for tags, subtle background panels, and hover washes that lift off the cream canvas

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Tertiary dividers and inactive UI elements — a mid-warm gray for the lightest structural lines

palette.name: Amber Signal
palette.role: Yellow outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color
